To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“A framework for the development of Z specifications in an OO style is presented.

the development of Z specifications in an OO style can be supported by a framework that: • Captures the OO concepts and design strategies in the application of development (refinement) operators; • Supports the identification of “classes” and, hence, modular refinement and verification; • Is supported by a tool that provides the user with a visual representation of a specification, its history and the classes that can be extracted from that history.

the object-oriented style of specification and design is a natural fit for Z, and that the development framework provides a mechanism for capturing object-oriented design strategies and for modular verification.

the application of object-oriented concepts and strategies within a formal specification language.
developing a methodology for Z that is both object-oriented and modular.
providing a formal framework for the development of object-oriented Z specifications.

the development framework is a useful tool for developing Z specifications, but that its application is not yet sufficiently mature for the framework to be used in a fully automatic way.

we have developed a framework for developing specifications in Z which is object oriented in nature and which can be used for the verification of object-oriented programs.

the framework provides a means to develop Z specifications in an incremental and object-oriented manner.
